title: Address all 6 open issues in konard/vietnam-accomodation-search
body:
<!-- hive-mind-solve-repository-mode -->

## Current status — 2026-09-27

PR [#49](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/pull/49) merged and automatically closed this umbrella plus all six sub-issues, but its own description explicitly listed immutable publication, complete browser coverage, deployment handoff/failure drills, native Telegram modes, and the private 40-source corpus as open acceptance gates.

The exact `0.12.3` rerun confirms those gates remain open: npm publication failed with `ENEEDAUTH`, the local suite is 790/791, browser coverage is 5 success/3 challenge/2 parse-incomplete, native mtcute modes remain unavailable, and Telegram binary projection again timed out at 600 seconds before a final report. Bot-only E2E and candidate Docker durability pass.

Sanitized evidence: [`docs/case-studies/revalidation-2026-09-27/README.md`](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/blob/a702800a76228daae13fa3eb90676138928235d6/docs/case-studies/revalidation-2026-09-27/README.md).

## Objective

Address every open issue listed below in [konard/vietnam-accomodation-search](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search) with a **single pull request** and keep this umbrella open until each sub-issue's acceptance checklist passes.

This issue was generated automatically by `/solve https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search` (repository mode, see https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/2212). Every issue below is attached to this issue as a GitHub native sub-issue.

## Scope

- Open acceptance issues: 6
- Issues attached as sub-issues of this issue: 6
- GitHub sub-issue limit per parent issue: 100

## Issues to address

- [ ] #16 Revalidate the privacy-safe 40-source Telegram audit on the next release
- [ ] #39 Bootstrap npm publication and complete the first immutable release
- [ ] #40 Make the complete 10-source VI/EN/RU browser audit pass
- [ ] #41 Fix deploy command execution and revalidate same-bind handoff
- [ ] #42 Complete identity-pinned native mtcute user-only and combined real E2E
- [ ] #43 Finish bounded, checkpointed 40-source Telegram acceptance

## Requirements

1. Read every issue listed above and satisfy its complete acceptance checklist, including explicitly authorized manual/live gates where required.
2. Do all of the work in one pull request. Do not defer a listed issue to a follow-up pull request.
3. Keep the pull request in draft while any acceptance item remains unchecked.
4. Use closing references only after one immutable candidate passes all six issue checklists; closing syntax is not acceptance evidence by itself.
5. Retain only sanitized aggregate evidence in Git. Never commit credentials, numeric identities, private source aliases, raw messages/pages, contacts, sessions, or private traces.

This umbrella is reopened because the linked issues were closed by syntax before their documented acceptance criteria passed.
